intro.text: A monastery in eastern Shinovar at the foot of the Misted Mountains.

description.text: The surrounding town occupies a ridge above barren ground. The monastery's walls survive, but its roof and chimney are damaged.

items.text: Nin waited at the monastery and demanded Szeth's obedience. Szeth refused both the oath and the fight Nin offered instead.
Kaladin fought in Szeth's place. His retelling of the Wandersail story reached Nin, who confronted his responsibility for the acts he had committed in the name of law.
